story.titleZh: 2026荷兰大奖赛排位赛：诺里斯暂列杆位
story.summaryZh: 在2026年荷兰大奖赛排位赛中，迈凯伦车队的兰多·诺里斯暂获杆位，领先于乔治·拉塞尔和安德烈亚·基米·安东内利。
story.summaryEn: Lando Norris of McLaren has taken provisional pole position for the 2026 Dutch Grand Prix, ahead of George Russell and Andrea Kimi Antonelli.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯代表迈凯伦车队获得荷兰大奖赛的临时杆位，领先于乔治·拉塞尔和安德烈亚·基米·安东内利。
佩雷兹：因更换悬挂调校将从维修区起步
皮埃尔·加斯利：在不安全放车调查中被认定无责
detailEn: Lando Norris has taken provisional pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix for McLaren ahead of George Russell and Andrea Kimi Antonelli.
Perez: Pit lane start due to suspension set-up change
Pierre Gasly: Cleared over unsafe release
keyPointsZh: 佩雷兹因更换悬挂调校将从维修区起步
加斯利在不安全放车调查中被认定无责
keyPointsEn: Perez will start from the pit lane due to a suspension set-up change.
Pierre Gasly was cleared over an unsafe release.
